![](https://www.fai.org/sites/default/files/styles/basic_page_highlighted_xlarge/public/banners_faidroneworld2018.png?itok=yAKMQBkG)
**Drone sports are growing as fast as ever with exciting initiatives springing up around the world!**
**Always pushing the limits of technology for velocity and agility, drone sports give spectators a glimpse into the world of tomorrow: incredible displays of skill, strategy and speed against a futuristic backdrop.**
#### Drone Racing
**FAI WORLD DRONE RACING CHAMPIONSHIP**
The FAI World Drone Racing Championship (WDRC) is the biggest competition of its kind, and offers an arena for the world’s elite drone racing pilots to pit their skills against one another.
  * [The 2024 edition took place in Hangzhou, China from 31 October 31 to 3 November.](https://www.fai.org/event/wdrc)


**FAI DRONE RACING WORLD CUP**
The FAI Drone Racing World Cup 2024 saw the victory of Korean pilot MinJae Kim.
  * [The 2025 edition has now started! Stay tuned!](https://www.fai.org/event/droneracingworldcup)


**THE WORLD GAMES**
The 12th edition of [The World Games](https://www.fai.org/event/worldgames) took place from 7 to 17 August 2025 in Chengdu city, People's Republic of China, and once again featured Drone Racing (13-16 August).
  * [Drone Racing at The World Games 2025](https://www.fai.org/event/worldgames2025)


#### E-Drone Racing
The first [FAI E-Drone Racing World Cup ](https://www.fai.org/event/edroneracingworldcup)series launched in 2024 and aims to introduce newcomers and gamers to the ultramodern world of drone racing, with its easily accessible format.
E-Drone racing is an online version of a physical drone race, accessible to a wide audience who can compete from the comfort of their favourite gaming chair, anywhere in the world.
#### Drone Soccer
For those who haven’t yet experienced Drone Soccer, this futuristic 3D football game is amazing to watch and even more amazing to play! 
The inaugural[ FAI World Drone Soccer Championships occured in China, from 15 to 18 November 2025](https://www.fai.org/event/news/drone-soccer-makes-history-shanghai-host-first-ever-fai-world-championships-2025?type=node&id=175683) at the state-of-the-art Shanghai Stadium.
